status: Proposed for trustees; not evidence of their authorization or actual submission
objective_order: Meet fixed nominal educational commitments without equity sales
Protect long-term purchasing power subject to funding security
Invest surplus within documented risk tolerance

initial_decision.benchmark: 100% VTI for the market-traded growth sleeve

instrument_constraints_from_assignment: Cash, listed US equity ETFs, US common stocks and the five case bonds only
No borrowing, short sales or derivatives
coupon_policy: Do not use Delta coupons to reduce Beta face. Hold the four pre-maturity Delta coupons not needed for liabilities as cash at a zero base rate.
evaluation_rule: Freeze 2022 growth allocation and VTI benchmark. For 2023-25, test both with an annual post-December return rebalance to inception growth weights, without parameter re-estimation. A one-ETF growth sleeve ordinarily has no internal trade.

risk_governance_proposal.primary_metric: Unitized total-return drawdown of the growth sleeve from its running high; account for external transfers
risk_governance_proposal.10_percent: Validate prices, dated-payment coverage and stress within two business days; no automatic trade
risk_governance_proposal.15_percent: Investment Committee meeting within five business days; document hold, already-authorized rebalance or prospective policy recommendation
risk_governance_proposal.20_percent: Notify trustees same or next business day and pause discretionary risk increases pending review; no forced sale
risk_governance_proposal.payment_shortfall_any_drawdown: Immediate escalation and funded corrective plan
risk_governance_proposal.crisis_exception: Only discretionary action may be delayed with written authority, expiry and review; payment coverage cannot be reduced

upside_review_proposal: At annual review, after liability check, assess whether the real 2030 goal remains funded after a 30% growth-sleeve shock. If so, trustees may prospectively lock the minimum required amount in a permitted, actually priced, goal-date-matched asset and leave the surplus under the growth policy. No fixed-gain sale or automatic spending increase.
change_control: Date every mandate, benchmark, policy or asset change; give before/after figures and effective date. Never back-edit the initial policy using 2023-25 returns.
